description.zh:
数据库ID，可通过调用接口[ListDatabases](~~141873~~)获取物理库ID的值，调用接口[ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~)获取逻辑库ID的值。
>DatabaseId的值即为DbId的值。
description.en:
The database ID. You can call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) operation to query the ID of a physical database and the [ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~) operation to query the ID of a logical database.

>  The value of DatabaseId is that of DbId.

description.zh:
表名。
>您可以通过调用接口[ListTables](~~141878~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en:
The table name.

> You can also call the [ListTables](~~141878~~) operation to query the table name.

description.zh: 表模式名，仅当SQLServer需要传递为架构名。
description.en: The schema name of the table, which is required only for SQL Server instances.

description.zh:
租户ID。

> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise remove-table-from-category --tid 30000 --category-id 30000235594 --db-id 43153 --table-name test_table --table-schema-name dbo --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise RemoveTableFromCategory --region cn-hangzhou --CategoryId 30000235594 --TableName test_table --TableSchemaName dbo --DbId 43153 --Tid 30000
